mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.title, f.path, f.author_id, f.created_at FROM files f INNER JOIN file_quote fq ON f.id = fq.file_id WHERE fq.article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
SELECT f.id, f.title, f.path, f.author_id, f.created_at FROM files f WHERE f.author_id = #{authorId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM file_quote fq WHERE fq.file_id = f.id) ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO files (id, title, path, author_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{path}, #{authorId}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO file_quote (article_id, file_id) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{fileId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM file_quote WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND file_id = #{fileId}
